context: Write a haiku about foolish behavior in the form of a question, for an audience of young readers. It should include the topic of not studying. Give exactly two different responses, separated by 6 asterisk symbols (******), and include a title wrapped in double angular brackets, i.e. <<title>>. Do not use commas.

trace.content:
<<Why Skip The Book?>>
Why skip the hard book?
Will you fail the big test soon?
No grades for you then

******

<<Lazy Study Time>>
Why not read the page?
Will the teacher be so kind?
No points for no work
